jobs_results.title: Sr Backend Developer - Ruby, Ruby on Rails
jobs_results.description:
About Zen Educate

Our mission is to change the world of education recruitment. Schools spend over £2bn a year on agency staff, with over £600m per year of that spent on fees that go straight to the recruitment agencies. So far, we've saved UK schools over £10m in supply teaching recruitment costs, and that number grows every day, meaning the funding can be put back into education within the schools. Using our online platform, schools have access to hundreds of profiles of fully vetted teachers and support staff, who they can book at a click of a button. Think Uber for teachers. We are well-funded by high-profile investors and are led by start-up veterans behind two of London's most prominent tech companies.

Building on the success of Zen Educate, in 2020 we launched Zen Locum — an online platform that matches locums (temporary workers) with pharmacies and opticians. With significant early traction we're looking to expand this team to continue driving growth.

We're well-funded by... high-profile investors and are led by start-up veterans behind two of London’s most prominent tech companies.

About The Role

Our mission is to change the world of education recruitment. Schools spend over £2bn a year on agency staff, with over £600m per year of that spent on fees that go straight to the recruitment agencies. So far, we've saved UK schools over £10m in supply teaching recruitment costs, and that number grows every day, meaning the funding can be put back into education within the schools. Using our online platform, schools have access to hundreds of profiles of fully vetted teachers and support staff, who they can book at a click of a button. Think Uber for teachers. We are well-funded by high-profile investors and are led by start-up veterans behind two of London's most prominent tech companies.

What You’ll Do

You’ll be joining Zen in a key position. The product delivery team is a crucial part of how Zen will help both transform the supply and recruitment experience for schools and generate the savings the education system needs. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to apply themselves for a great cause and with great responsibility and autonomy to shape our product and development for years to come. We're looking for talented engineer looking to take their skills to the next level by joining a growing, high-performing product delivery team in an agile environment. You'll be:
• Picking up, owning and deploying new features from scratch, working closely with front-end developers
• Reviewing PRs and helping us improve our ways of working
• Investigating and tackling new challenges and responding to bugs
• Writing high quality, well-tested code

What You’ll Bring
• Experience with Ruby, Ruby on Rails (6yrs+)
• Experience refactoring legacy code and considering trade-offs around technical debt - A top performer that wants to be part of a high-performing, motivated team
• Growth mindset — dedicated to growing your skills as a professional
• Passion for work with a positive social impact

jobs_results.title: Backend Engineer RoR
jobs_results.description:
About Vesto

Vesto is an investment platform that allows anyone to put their money to work in a fun, simple and guided way.

Their mission is to help people invest in their future and manage their assets and wealth.

Backed by UNIQ, the benchmark fintech and blockchain venture studio in Western Europe.

The team

Their vision is **to be the place where people can get everything they need to build their financial freedom, overcome life's challenges and afford a better life in the future**.

They are creating the investment app that allows anyone to access financial products to build a sustainable investment portfolio that allows them to overcome life's challenges and afford a better life in the future.

Working at Vesto is about wanting to influence the future of our generation and build the product that helps them make it possible. They are convinced that there is a simple and accessible way for anyone to monetize their savings and they are here to build this space and have an impact... on changing the way ALL voices in the financial market participate and interact with each other.

That's why they are creating an ecosystem that will allow their users to leverage their savings in an easy and intuitive way, providing a community where influencers, investors, banks and financial advisors interact with each other around any type of financial product such as stocks, ETFs, Mutual Funds, Crypto, Commodities.

And since they launched 1 year ago they have been listed as the top 30 most downloaded app in Spain 5 times!

The project
• As a Back-End Developer at Vesto, you will be responsible for the server-side code and APIs of their mobile application.
• You will be involved in the entire product development cycle, including design, development, implementation and maintenance of new and existing features.
• Your work will impact the stability and quality of their mobile applications.
• You will write reusable and maintainable code.
• Ultimately, you will be the driving force behind all back-end activities.

Your mission

You will be responsible for designing and developing scalable and reliable back-end systems, ensuring that they are secure and meet the highest standards of data privacy.

You will also work with front-end developers to integrate the back-end systems with the user interface, ensuring a seamless user experience.

You will be expected to keep up with the latest trends and technologies in back-end development, and to share your knowledge and expertise with the rest of the team.

In this role, you will work closely with our product engineering team to understand the requirements and translate them into functional, high-quality code.

You will need to write reusable and maintainable code that adheres to industry standards and best practices.

What they expect from you
• You are a startup lover and thrive in this type of companies (1-20 employees only)
• You have experience with the programming language Ruby, specifically with the framework Ruby On Rails.
• You have experience with Postgresql and the relational model in general.
• You're analytical and good at time management.
• You have great problem-solving skills and you work well in a team.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• At least 3 years of experience in startups preferably in a fintech or financial organization.
• Strong technical background and hands-on experience with software development, infrastructure management, and cloud technologies.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills
• Fluent in english preferible but not mandatory
• EU based

Benefits & perks
• Competitive salary, flexible work schedules and a supportive and collaborative work environment.
• Opportunities for professional growth and development, including attendance at conferences, workshops and other training programs.
• At Vesto, they highly value innovation, creativity and a passion for making a difference in the world.
• Someone who thrives in this type of environment, working alongside a small team of 1-20 employees.
• You will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology and have a real impact on the financial technology industry.
• If you are passionate about developing high quality software and making a difference in people's lives, we want to hear from you

jobs_results.description:

Información sobre el trabajo:
Senior Engineer

Información completa del trabajo.
Nombre de vacante Senior Engineer Descripción We are seeking a highly skilled Senior UI Engineer (ideally full stack or with backend knowledge) to join our Service Fabric team in Barcelona.

Service Fabric is a technology platform that enables Sage to deliver common capabilities required across multiple Sage cloud or cloud-connected products.

As a Senior Engineer, you are going to collaborate in the design, develop and delivery of high-quality products and services that exceed customers’ or business partners’ expectations.

You will be part of a team inside Sage’s global Service Fabric organisation, located in multiple countries around the globe. You’ll be part of a dynamic team focused on integration and enablement activities. Responsabilidades principal... es Your responsibilities will be to:

• Design and develop user interfaces for web applications (mobile friendly), using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and related front-end frameworks such as React and/or Angular

• Collaborate with designers, product managers, and back-end developers to ensure a seamless user experience

• Translate UI/UX design wireframes into high-quality code

• Develop reusable UI components and libraries

• Optimize user interfaces for performance and responsiveness

• Mentor and lead other engineers in the team

• Participate in code reviews to maintain high code quality standards

• Improve code quality by implementing best practices and design patterns

• Communicate with other teams to understand requirements and propose solutions

We would love to meet you if you:

• Have developed using a variety of technologies, with experience in front-end frameworks - React and/or Angular.

• Hands-on experience in .NET backend development. Knowledge of Node.

JS

• Keen interest in learning new programming languages and tools.

• You enjoy reading code and fully understanding the environment in which it runs, from the network stack to the back-end storage layers and everything in between.

• Experience with AWS or an alternative cloud environment

• Experience working with Agile methodologies and CI/CD processes

• Familiarity with development and deployment of cloud-based products

Independently of your technical profile and background, we put value on collaboration and communication skills, displaying an agile mindset and having reasonable amounts of autonomy and accountability.

Why you would love to join us?

Impact:
You’ll be working alongside a tremendous team of highly skilled engineers on products that make a real impact on our customers.

Culture:

You will be working in a multicultural and diverse environment.

Environment:
Fantastic tech environment, using the best of breed and cutting-edge technologies.

Community:
Make a difference to communities we live and work in, with your 5 volunteer days every year. How we are making a difference

Continuous Development:
Unlimited access to Pluralsight, Linkedin Learning and Sage University.

Career Growth:
Long-term prospects for a professional career. Access to Talent Marketplace, an internal system that uses artificial intelligence to create a clear path for growth.

The flexible Human Work approach will provide you an opportunity to unlock all forms of flexibility (mode, location, and time).

Brand office space, locates at the heart of Barcelona’s 22@tech district, with great transport links.

Reduced working hours in the summer.

Flexible benefits that suit your needs.

Ready to take up this challenge? Apply today or contact us for more information.

From our colleagues delivering ground-breaking solutions to the customers who use them: people have helped us grow for more than forty years, and people are driving our future as a great SaaS company. We're writing our next chapter. Be part of it!

At Sage, we recognize that the world of work has rapidly shifted over the last few years, particularly how we work. That is why we have committed to working in a hybrid way going forward. Human connection is an essential ingredient of the 4 principles that make up our Flexible Human Work hybrid framework and we want to be transparent in what that looks like when you join our Sage family.

On one hand, our offices will continue to play an important role in our future and serve as a place for spontaneous conversations, connection, collaboration as well as focused time. jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer​/Remote
jobs_results.description:
Posición: Senior Software Engineer (Remote )

About us:

Have you always wanted to put your passion for education to use on the job? Would you like to work with an incredible team making an impact on learning around the world? If you answered yes, we can't wait to meet you!

And just who are we? Edpuzzle is a leading edtech company with offices in San Francisco and Barcelona and nearly 10 years of history helping teachers find and create exciting, interactive video lessons. Over 80% of U.S. schools and millions of teachers and students in 190+ countries around the world are already using Edpuzzle to make education more equitable and engaging.

About the role:

We’re looking for our next Senior Software Engineer to join the Engineering Team in Spain
. The right person will help us create the best possible product for teachers and empower them to engage their students with videos. Our Engineering Team is composed of Full Stack Software Engineers with different levels of seniority. This... allows us to learn from each other and get to know our product in-depth, end to end, with continuous deployments twice per day, and collaborate on scalable projects to achieve challenging goals together!

You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to our product and our team development, be a part of diverse projects, and stay up to date with the latest software technologies. In the process, you’ll be challenged daily, learn constantly, see the impact of your opinions and work, and grow as a Software Engineer.

What technologies will you find?

Technically speaking, we use
React
and
Redux
for our frontend and
Node,Express
, and
MongoDB
in the backend. We work with
testing, hexagonal architecture, DDD, CI/CD
, and deploy every day making sure we never compromise on code quality and reliability. We’re fully hosted on
AWS
which we also use to store, encode and stream our own pool of videos.

Wondering what it’s like to work at Edpuzzle?

Picture a place where you can connect with your teammates, whether remotely or in person, whenever you need support. A place where one day you're helping shape one of the biggest edtech platforms in the world, and the next day you're doing a team building activity with your coworkers. A place where everyone has been selected because they're the best at what they do, and where your manager and team trust your decisions fully.

A place where you're encouraged to learn and grow because education is the cornerstone of everything we do. Check out the job details below to see if Edpuzzle could be the right fit for you!
About you:
• 6 years or more of experience in front-end, back-end, or full-stack development
• An open-minded attitude with technologies and development
• Experience writing well-tested Java Script code
• Experience with at least one frontend framework (React, Vue, Svelte, etc.) and with high-traffic backend systems in any language
• You have experience managing projects with autonomy
• You have experience proposing technical solutions and making architectonic decisions
• You have experience leading and mentoring more junior colleagues
• You are excited by the opportunity of working in education
• You make all your technology decisions with the final user in mind
• You love learning and mastering technologies
• You have an excellent ability to communicate your ideas, regardless of the audience
• You feel comfortable communicating in English within an international and multicultural team
• You are
based in Spain
and have a work permit to work in Spain
Bonus skills
• MongoDB
• Redis
• Elasticsearch
• Messaging systems like Rabbit

MQ, SQS, etc
• Cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, Google App Engine, etc
• … or another amazing skill you bring to the table that we haven’t thought of yet!
What’s it like to work remotely?
• Work from the comfort of your own home
• Use the Edpuzzle office as much or as little as you like
• Meet with your manager and team via video calls on Google Meet or Slack
• Connect with coworkers via Slack (with channels for work and for fun!)
• To enjoy our remote work policy, you’ll need high-speed internet access
What we offer:

About us:

Have you always wanted to put your passion for education to use on the job? Would you like to work with an incredible team making an impact on learning around the world? If you answered yes, we can't wait to meet you!

And just who are we? Edpuzzle is a leading edtech company with offices in San Francisco and Barcelona and nearly 10 years of history helping teachers find and create exciting, interactive video lessons. Over 80% of U.S. schools and millions of teachers and students in 190+ countries around the world are already using Edpuzzle to make education more equitable and engaging.

About the role:

We’re looking for our next Senior Software Engineer to join the Engineering Team in Spain
. The right person will help us create the best possible product for teachers and empower them to engage their students with videos. We are looking for you, if you are a Senior Backend Developer with a minimum experience of 3 years and with knowledge in C#, REST APIs, to work for an important IT company.

• Experience with Relational Databases (SQL Server)
• Experience with ADO .Net and Entity Framework.
• Experience in project analysis and valuation.
• Knowledge designing and implementing quality technical solutions.

jobs_results.title: Software Developer
jobs_results.description:
Funciones

Tu rol: Tu principal desafío será el desarrollo completo y desde cero de soluciones SaaS, EDI, de facturación electrónica y cumplimiento tributario (VAT Compliance, eReporting...).

Al situar la solución, el producto en el centro, llegarás a participar en todas las fases del proyecto de desarrollo: análisis de sistemas y requisitos, diseño y arquitectura de software, programación e implementación, verificación y pruebas, documentación...

¿Cómo superar el reto?
• Tu primer paso y más importante en EDICOM será participar de un curso de formación y especialización inicial de seis semanas aproximadamente a tiempo completo. En ella te enseñaremos todo sobre las soluciones SaaS EDI, facturación electrónica y cumplimiento tributario.
• Una vez hayas completado esta fase, te incorporarás a uno de los equipos del área de I+D desde el que recibirás una formación más especifica y multidisciplinar. Los equipos de I+D, están compuestos por developers de frontend, backend, arquitectos y... devops que despliegan las aplicaciones en el cloud de EDICOM.
• Nuestro objetivo (el tuyo y el de EDICOM) es que en el tiempo más corto posible puedas adquirir un rol de Fullstack Developer que te permita dominar los distintos perfiles que hay dentro de un equipo (frontend, backend, arquitecto y devops). Para ello:Frontend journey. Recibirás formación y trabajarás con Angular (framework empleado en el desarrollo de aplicaciones web) y adquirirás conocimientos en NgRx, Redux, Angular Material y desarrollo de componentes WEB.Backend journey. Nuestro lenguaje es Java, apoyándonos en el framework Spring, para el desarrollo de aplicaciones. Recibirás formación y te desarrollarás en el framework de Spring, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Integration y Spring Batch. Para el desarrollo de las aplicaciones de backend te apoyarás en distintos sistemas de almacenamiento:MYSQL como sistema relacional de base de datos.ELASTICSEARH como motor de búsqueda.CEPH como repositorio de objetos.HAZELCAST como sistema distribuido de memoria, necesario para el desarrollo de microservicios y aplicaciones que corren en el cloud de EDICOM.
• También construirás backends utilizando otras tecnologías como:NODEJS y el framework NestJS.Python y el framework FastAPI, para el desarrollo de proyectos de machine learning.
• Una vez obtengas autonomía en lo anterior, el siguiente paso será diseñar y arquitectar los nuevos desarrollos que se solicitan al departamento de I+D desde el área de negocio o dirección.
• Tras todos estos pasos, te quedará desplegar todo lo anteriormente desarrollado en la infraestructura de cloud dedicada de EDICOM. El cloud de EDICOM se apoya en Kubernetes y en un PaaS que nos ayudará en la tarea de desplegar aplicaciones. Para realizar esta tarea se emplearán tecnologías como:GITLAB para el desarrollo de la integración continua y despliegue continuo (CI/CD). CUE como lenguaje que nos permitirá definir la infraestructura que se despliega en Kubernetes.DOCKER para creación de los contenedores que se van a desplegar.
• Te acompañaremos realizando tutorizaciones recurrentes y continuas, cada tres meses durante el primer año, para que te sientas guiado. Queremos que crezcas hacia donde quieras: Scrum Master, Product Owner...

Requisitos

Qué buscamos en ti:
• Grado en Ingeniería Informática, T.S. Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Multiplataformas y T.S. Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Web. Siempre con el mismo denominador común: pasión por el desarrollo de software.
• Se valora experiencia previa en las tecnologías requeridas y en las responsabilidades definidas, así como recién titulados o candidaturas de estudiantes de últimos años de grado que busquen estabilidad y carrera profesional.
• Se tendrá en cuenta buen expediente académico.

Ventajas del puesto

Qué te ofrecemos:
• Formarás parte de equipos de Investigación y Desarrollo de primer nivel que desarrollan soluciones propias compitiendo tecnológicamente en todo el mundo.
• Desde el primer momento, podrás valorar, proponer e innovar en todas las fases del proyecto de desarrollo. Esto será posible gracias a las metodologías ágiles y la eficiente comunicación entre departamentos y equipos de la que disfrutamos en EDICOM.
• Dispondrás de KPIs de productividad, que medirán tu valía y proyectarán tu carrera profesional.
• Quedará a tu alcance una carrera profesional definida y clara, desde la que podrás acceder a posiciones como Scrum Master, Product Owner..

¿Te sumas a nuestro equipo #TopTechTalent?

Contrato indefinido, estable

Horario flexible

Formación continua

Clases de idiomas gratuitas

Plan de carrera profesional

Revisiones salariales periódicas

Seguro médico

Retribución flexible

• Estabilidad laboral.

• Posibilidad de realizar proyectos internacionales.
